summary: Paperless-ngx is a self-hosted document management system that lets you digitise, index, and archive physical paperwork through a web interface. It acts as a central repository for scanned files, converting them into searchable formats for easier retrieval.
goodFor: It is well-suited for home users or small offices wanting to reduce physical clutter by moving invoices, receipts, and letters into a searchable digital archive.
watchOut: OCR processing and text extraction can be resource-intensive during initial ingestion, potentially straining lower-powered home server hardware.
deployNotes: As a containerised application built with Python, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for uploaded files and a database backend, along with a reverse proxy for handling TLS.
